## My Info

I'm a master of Business Analytics student at Monash University, with an academic background in Network and New media.

I'm interested in exploring how data can be used to understand real-world problems and support better decision-making. My main interests include data analysis, statistical modelling, data visualization, and data storytelling.

Through my studies, I have developed practical experience using R, SQL, Quarto, and GitHub to analyse datasets, create visualizations, and produce reproducible reports.
